column1: # Preprint Table 2 (tab:gamma) re-measured for the v6.2 release: v6, v6f (default, F32N + F32N_NOFIX) and v6fp (v6f precise, F32N with the field-floor fix) kernels, library readback (tests/gpu/table2_v6_2.mjs), commit f6beda5 + working tree
# Renderer: ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (Subzero) (0x0000C0DE)), SwiftShader driver) (IEEE float32 software rendering). Accuracy only, no timings.
# Relative L2 error vs the exact LW field, no softening. sweep: 256 observers across the synchrotron pulse at R_ret = 1.15 (f32 = rounded to float32 and
# compared at the rounded point; df64 = double-float observer coordinates); ring: 64 observers at radius 1.15. Ring-buffer history (16 steps), as the paper.
# known_*: the same sweep with known-path shells (exact knots, C2 quintic). v5: the version-5 algorithm (deposited shader). At gamma = 224 only df64 is meaningful.
# v6 columns reproduce results/tables.json to 0.0e+0 relative (unchanged kernel).
